invalidation.invalidation_detail: Reclassify the descending state if the trading-timeframe lower-high/lower-low sequence fails and price sustains acceptance above the short-term resistance boundary with improving participation.

hard_anchors: Deterministic short-term structure is coherent descending, with a defined declining support/resistance framework and no confirmed breakout.
Long-term structure remains descending, although its early-bull-reversal phase marks a transition risk rather than a directional reclassification.
Price is below the fast, intermediate, and longer moving-average references; the short EMA hierarchy remains bearishly ordered.
Short-horizon ATR is modestly below the longer ATR measure, consistent with stable normal realized volatility rather than fresh expansion.
Latest turnover is below its 20-session average and each of the last three volume readings is sub-average, indicating contracting participation.
Current price is situated between nearby support and resistance, while overhead short-term resistance remains unresolved.
A neutral doji accompanies bullish base-pattern detections near repeated lows; these patterns have not produced a confirmed structural reversal.
event_modifiers: No dated earnings release, macroeconomic print, policy action, filing, or identifiable idiosyncratic shock was supplied as a contemporaneous state driver.
narrative_residual: Research-manager recommendation and all allocation, timing, and execution language were excluded from state estimation.
Bullish and bearish advocacy in the supplied plan was treated as low-weight rhetoric rather than directional evidence.
contradictory_signals: Bullish triple-bottom, double-bottom, and cup-and-handle detections conflict with the aligned deterministic descending structure.
The long-term early-bull-reversal phase conflicts with the still-bearish moving-average hierarchy and short-term trend.
A neutral doji and nearby support reduce impulse clarity, while sub-average volume does not confirm either reversal or continuation.
